prompt_set:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: CH01 S 90-degree four-pose animation source B, requested native2048square transparent PNG. Reference1 locks EXACT adult male character, armor/axe design, body scale, paintfinish AND same TRUE facing/camera as its four poses. Draw NEW B poses, not source A repeats. Reference2 is identity only.
Target direction for all: true frontal face/chest and full pair of eyes symmetrical; shoes and attack point directly DOWN toward viewer (0,1), no sideways face. High-camera nearisometric2.5D slanted overhead, real anatomical redrawing, never mirror/rotate. Adultshortbrownhair warrior; navy fittedsplitcoat, silverarmor/goldfittings, vermilion scarf, darkpants, silverboots, goldsilver volcanic crescent giantaxe with orangesunstone. Warmclean handpainted cartoonfantasy and excellent materialdetail.
Exact2x2 rowmajor FOUR COMPLETE isolated figures: top-left basic_release, final heavy slash CONTACT toward target direction, arms and compact blade extended just in front of torso/knees, visible committed weightshift; top-right basic_recovery, drawing heavy blade back besidehip, shoulders center; bottom-left dash, strong forwardbody lean/lunge toward same target, axe tucked behindhip, head and full anatomy visible, no trails; bottom-right guard_cast, upright wide braced legs, shaft acrosschest with entireblade beside torso, battlecry pose. Make release different from stationaryguard; show a physical axe downswing, not a shield pose.
Every complete sprite fits own quadrant with35px emptyalpha border on each side, whole weapon and bothshoes visible, shortscarf, elbowbend, compactblade, no pixel reaches neighbor. If canvas1254, rectangles x35..592 or662..1219 and y35..592 or662..1219. Headtop toaveragebootground450–550 actualpixels whereupright, sameactual anatomy asA; full figure+weapon widthunder530. Do not crop or resize anatomy only becauseaxe large, tightenstance andaxe angle. Genuinealpha only. No floor, shadows, particles, FXtrails, detachedfragments, gridlines, labels, text,watermarks or extra characters.
